definitions: Durations include all store markers in each measured policy generation, including final drain. Exposed times intersect conservative all-rank inter-compute gaps. Nested markers overlap: do not sum them as an additive latency breakdown. Producer/stream readiness is a CPU-side snapshot at dependency submission. Allocation counters describe the selection from already-known pending stores only. In the independent load path, load_ready_states describes its private ready stream; independent_compute_states records the original compute stream.
